provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Sylvavéryn is centered at 8.066809, -86.299300 under Theocracy, with 103,614,000 people across 10 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Sylvavéryn occupies 9,634,777.67 sq mi / 24,953,959.60 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 4.892301% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Partial forest and Beach and grass with water define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water and Treetops - treehouses. Population density is 4.152 people/sq km / 10.754 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Harengon, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Freeblade Veil, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Asethyr, Thalunesh, Marduthor, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 8 recorded four-province geography group links, including 7 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Elder Lorn Fogfellow
npcs.description:
Elder Lorn Fogfellow is a bitter, weather-beaten Rainforest Dril’thar guide who knows every drowned trail, fog-choked root bridge, and monster path around Syl'thara. As a Dril’thar, he carries Bastveig’s living-water memory and the rainforest line’s Sigrananna influence, making him a natural hunter, navigator, and keeper of grief-soaked places where water remembers the dead.
At the Choral Synod Guidehouse, Lorn leads travelers through cursed mists, ichor-warped marsh pockets, and old rainforest routes that less experienced scouts do not survive. He is stubborn, cynical, hard-drinking, and openly hostile toward zealots who romanticize divine contamination, but beneath the growl is a lonely elder who still wants someone worth teaching before the fog finally takes him.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Syl'thara is a Village in Sylvavéryn, under Theocracy, with moderate danger, Partial forest, Deep forest, Beach and grass with water terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Rainforest Dril’thar reads through the Dril'thar entry of the race compendium, within Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, marked by Bastveig. The local form is read through Rainforest. Amphibious Mystics of the Living Waters. Table cues: ancestral instincts, homeland pressure, and local reputation; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Elder Lorn Fogfellow knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Marduday.
Elder Lorn Fogfellow has a contact in Scalori who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Elder Lorn Fogfellow asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Elder Lorn Fogfellow's public story is incomplete.
